ads_not_whole.text: Not proven: some ads were not whole and were left out

board_anomalies.text: Not proven: the answer held something unexpected (see the run's warnings)

board_complete.text: Proven: the board was read in full

board_empty.text: Not proven: the board answered with no ads

board_not_complete.text: Not proven: the board was not read in full

board_unreadable.text: Not proven: the board could not be read

boards_not_proven.text: Not proven: at least one board was not read in full (see the boards)

discards_damaged.text: Not proven: the record of dropped ads is missing or damaged

discards_mismatch.text: Not proven: the record of dropped ads does not match what the source reported

end_check_failed.text: Not proven: the end-of-list request failed

end_check_not_a_list.text: Not proven: the end-of-list request did not answer with a list

end_not_checked.text: Not proven: the end of the list was not checked

files_dont_add_up.text: Not proven: this run's files do not account for every ad of the board

files_torn.text: Not proven: the source's staging file was cut short

no_board_evidence.text: Not proven: this source gave no per-board proof

no_proof_available.text: Not proven: this kind of board offers no completeness proof, so its ads are never closed or marked Stale

no_search_key.text: Not proven: the run has no search key

no_total.text: Not proven: the answer did not report a total to check against

not_finished.text: Not proven: the source did not run to its end (it was stopped or cancelled)

nothing_read.text: Not proven: the source answered but returned no ads

parts_failed.text: Not proven: some parts of the source failed

postings_past_end.text: Not proven: the board listed postings past the ones read

proven.text: Proven: the source finished, lost nothing, its files add up, and it returned ads

run_cancelled.text: Not proven: the run was cancelled, and a cancelled run proves nothing

source_in_doubt.text: Not proven: the source did not finish cleanly

source_partial.text: Not proven: the source read only some of its parts

source_skipped.text: Not proven: the source did not search in this run

staged_differs.text: Not proven: what was saved to staging differs from what the source returned

total_differs.text: Not proven: the total the board reports is not the number of postings read
